title: Recipe for Disaster
description: The Dark Brotherhood tasks the player with killing the Gourmet, a famous chef whose identity is secret, in order to impersonate him and poison the Emperor's meal. The player must extract the Gourmet's identity from Anton Virane, silence him, then assassinate the Gourmet and steal his Writ of Passage.

base_facts: I lead the Dark Brotherhood sanctuary.
We have a scheme to impersonate the Gourmet and poison the Emperor's meal.
Festus Krex is directing this phase of the operation.

QUEST_COMPLETE: All the pieces are in place and the time to move against the Emperor has come.
I instructed the Listener to head to Castle Dour in Solitude to fulfill their duties.
The next phase of the Emperor's assassination, To Kill an Empire, is ready to begin.

base_facts: I am a senior member of the Dark Brotherhood.
The Gourmet's true identity is known by very few.
Anton Virane owns an autographed copy of Uncommon Taste and may know who the Gourmet really is.

REPORT_TO_FESTUS: Your target is the Gourmet. Kill him and take his identity so we can poison the Emperor's meal.
REPORT_TO_FESTUS_FINAL: The Gourmet is dead and we have the Writ of Passage. The plan to move against the Emperor proceeds.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I rewarded the assassin with leveled gold for killing the Gourmet and retrieving the Writ of Passage.
If the Gourmet's body was successfully hidden, I also awarded the Nightweaver's Band as a bonus.
I directed the assassin to speak with Astrid, as the time to strike at the Emperor has finally come.

base_facts: I work in the Understone Keep kitchen in Markarth.
I own an autographed copy of Uncommon Taste.
I know the Gourmet's true identity.

QUESTION_ANTON_VIRANE: The Gourmet is an Orc named Balagog gro-Nolob.
Balagog gro-Nolob can be found at the Nightgate Inn.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Anton Virane is dead, silenced to prevent him from revealing the Gourmet's true identity.
His elimination ensures the Dark Brotherhood's operation to impersonate the Gourmet remains a secret.

base_facts: I am the Gourmet, the famous chef whose identity is secret.
I am an Orc staying at the Nightgate Inn.
I carry a Writ of Passage that proves my identity as the Gourmet.

QUEST_COMPLETE: Balagog gro-Nolob is dead, and his Writ of Passage has been taken to allow the impersonation.
His death clears the way for the assassin to pose as the Gourmet and poison the Emperor's meal.

beats.comment: Player reports to Festus Krex to learn about the Gourmet contract.
Player questions Anton Virane in Understone Keep to learn the Gourmet's identity.
Player must kill Anton Virane to silence him as a potential witness.
Player kills Balagog gro-Nolob, the Gourmet, at the Nightgate Inn.
Player takes the Writ of Passage from Balagog's corpse.
Player returns to Festus Krex with the Writ of Passage.
Quest completes. The Gourmet is dead and the player holds the Writ of Passage for the next phase.
